value:
Reverie v1.0.0 launch retrospective. SHIPPED 2026-05-07.

THE STORY: codexCLI v1.14.0 was the last release under the old name. 2026-05-06 the rebrand decision locked (see project.identity). v1.0.0-beta.0 (2026-05-06) carried the surface rebrand (binary, package, repo, env vars). v1.0.0-beta.1 carried the deep rebrand (.codexcli/ → .reverie/, codex_* → reverie_*, CODEX_* → RVR_*). v1.0.0-beta.2 attempted the Bun commit-phase but trapped at runtime; v1.0.0-beta.3 hot-fixed it. Issue #111 (zsh completions hyphen) was caught and fixed in stable. v1.0.0 stable shipped with all 4 binaries (linux x64/arm64, macOS universal, win-x64.exe), Homebrew formula, and 19 MCP tools verified end-to-end.

V1.0.0 vs V2.0.0 DECISION (preserved): Chose v1.0.0 (new product launch) over v2.0.0 (codexCLI continuation) because the product is genuinely different ("CLI for dot-notation datastore" → "bicameral memory layer for AI-assisted dev"); marketing favors "introducing Reverie" over "codexCLI v2"; git history continues (rename, not fork) preserving dogfooding case studies; clean SEO/search reset. SemVer: re-baselined under the new product name; codexCLI history honored via renamed repo + CHANGELOG provenance section.

WHAT'S NEXT (NOT engineering-driven):
- Phase 4 (commercial): SeaBear product page seabear.dev/reverie, consulting tier/pricing, "Reverie for Teams" landing.
- Phase 5 (launch comms): bicameral-story blog post, Dogfooding Part Three, GitHub inbound outreach, optional HN/Reddit.
- Visual identity: logo/wordmark, palette, marketing site.

DEFERRED to v1.1+:
- Test-runner swap (vitest → bun:test) — see project.bunMigrationScope.
- Web app / visualization layer.
- Search improvements (#13 fzf, #43 boolean operators).
- Entry health / staleness work (#84).
- Cross-machine telemetry aggregation.

SUPERSEDES: project.v114Plan and project.v115Hints (those remain as historical record).

The pre-launch project.releasePlan (full 7-workstream plan with phasing, decisions, sequence) was replaced by this retrospective on 2026-05-07. Pre-launch plan recoverable from git history of .reverie/project.releasePlan.json if needed.
